== Summary ==
Slip “•Jaxxon T. Tumperakki” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 986, 1102, 1709)). Version [[Jaxxon T. Tumperakki (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
